title: ESQL compute node intermittently fails on invoices missing optional 'discountCode' field
description: The invoice enrichment flow processes invoices from 5 different suppliers. Three suppliers always include a discountCode field in their JSON, but two suppliers omit it. When an invoice without discountCode arrives, the ESQL compute node throws a null reference error and the invoice goes to the dead-letter queue.

worklogs.description: Reviewed ESQL code for the compute node. Found the line: SET OutputRoot.JSON.Data.discount = InputRoot.JSON.Data.invoice.discountCode. No null check present.
Prepared fix: wrapping the field access in an EXISTS check and defaulting to empty string when absent.

comments.author: agent
comments.message: Hello, I found the issue in the ESQL code. The compute node directly reads the discountCode field without checking whether it exists first. When a supplier omits this optional field, the ESQL throws an error. The fix is simple - I will add a null check so the code gracefully handles the missing field by defaulting to an empty string. Before I deploy the fix, could you share sample invoice payloads from both suppliers that omit the discountCode? I want to make sure there are no other optional...

comments.author: customer
comments.message: Good idea to check all fields. I will ask the integration team to provide sample payloads from all 5 suppliers. Should have them by tomorrow.

comments.author: agent
comments.message: Perfect. Once I have all 5 samples I can do a full audit of all field references in the ESQL and make the fix comprehensive rather than just patching the discountCode issue. Looking forward to the samples.
